title: Add criterion-level submission claims and independent verification records
description: Implement the approved TASK-277 structured-evidence slice after durable author identity and run manifests exist. Extend submissions with per-criterion claimed status and evidence references linked to task revision and run ID; keep reviewer verified status separate so review can reject one criterion without rewriting implementer claims. Output sequencing: shared lifecycle and base-schema paths must be registered only after TASK-278 and TASK-281 release; begin with task-specific module and migration outputs.
acceptance_criteria: Each acceptance criterion has a stable identifier and submission claimed status linked to canonical author, task revision, and run ID.
Required evidence references are existence-checked and a criterion cannot be claimed complete when mandatory evidence is missing.
Reviewer verified status is stored separately from implementer claims and can reject one criterion without mutating the original submission record.
Submission, review, rejection, rework, and resubmission preserve an auditable append-only history without creating a competing task authority.
Migration, compatibility, lifecycle, mirror, and event tests pass with a documented rollback path.
